title: Bacteriocin protein architecture and minimum inhibitory concentration analysis
description: Reproducible data, code, bioinformatics outputs, figures, and tables for an interval-aware analysis of bacteriocin protein architecture and minimum inhibitory concentration. Version 1.1 expands the evidence base to 47 observations from 22 proteins and adds family, assay, study, cluster-bootstrap, robust-regression, and held-out-protein prediction analyses.
